items.prompt: A minimalist flat vector illustration of an explorer holding a magnifying glass, examining a map. The explorer's entire body is visible, with the magnifying glass positioned to clearly show a portion of the map within its lens, suggesting close observation. The illustration features a thick, confident black outline, saturated but tasteful colors with subtle 2-3 step cel-shading for volume, and is set against a solid, pure #00B140 chroma key green background. The subject is centrally placed, filling approximately 80% of the 1:1 square frame, ensuring a clean, even margin of the green background is visible on all four sides, with no part of the explorer or map touching the canvas border. This design is intended for universal use in business presentations.
